newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: La Tondena hikes stake in alcohol maker.
newsitem.headline: La Tondena hikes stake in alcohol maker.

text.p: Liquor-maker La Tondena Distillers Inc said on Tuesday it has acquired 60 percent of unlisted Distileria Bago Inc (DBI), making it now its 100 percent unit.
Rene Bermio, assistant vice president of La Tondena, told Reuters DBI provides a strategic advantage to La Tondena because it provides 45 to 50 percent of its alcohol requirements.
DBI is located in Bago city, Negros Occidental in central Philippines.
The company did not disclose the purchase price of the additional 60 percent stake.
